bio.text: Adam Hamilton won the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in Kansas in August 2026 and will face Republican incumbent Roger Marshall in November.
He is the founding member and senior pastor of United Methodist Church of the Resurrection in Leawood, Kansas, and has written more than 30 books.
Hamilton graduated from Oral Roberts University in 1985 and holds a Master of Divinity degree from Southern Methodist University.

sources.title: Kansas pastor enters U.S. Senate race as Democrat, wants to give Roger Marshall an early retirement
Adam Hamilton wins Democratic primary, advances to November Senate race
